page_title: SEV 1-2 VAL | Sevilla v Valencia 11/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+13' Jose Sanchez is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+12' Suso (Sevilla) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
90+12' Suso (Sevilla) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
90+12' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Sevilla will take a free kick.
90+11' The corner from Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) is hurriedly cleared.
90+11' Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) sends a long ball in, but Giorgi Mamardashvili comfortably gathers the ball. The ball is out of play. Sevilla will have a chance to score from a corner.
90+10' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

90+9' Suso (Sevilla) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the right-hand post, but Giorgi Mamardashvili was alert and the score remains the same. Sevilla have a corner.
90+7' Jose Sanchez blows his whistle and it's Hugo Duro (Valencia) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
90+6' Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) has too much to say to the referee and receives a caution.
90+5' Gabriel Paulista (Valencia) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
90+5' Gabriel Paulista (Valencia) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
90+4' Gabriel Paulista (Valencia) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
90+1' Referee Jose Sanchez points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Valencia players celebrate.
90' 11 additional min. will be played.
90' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an infringement in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Valencia players aren’t happy.
88' 1 - 2 GOAL! Superb work from Hugo Duro, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Javi Guerra (Valencia), who beats Bono with a brilliant shot into the top left corner. 1:2.
87' The game has come to an end for Jose Gaya. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Jesus Vazquez (Valencia).
86' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) receives the ball and has a go from distance, but he shouldn't have bothered as it sails high over the bar.
85' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
85' Pablo Gozalbez (Valencia) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jose Sanchez saw the whole situation.
84' What an opportunity! Pepelu (Valencia) picked the ball up and fired a projectile of a shot from long range which threatened the goalkeeper. The shot went painfully close to the left post!
82' Substitution. Youssef En Nesyri will be replaced by Federico Gattoni (Sevilla).
81' Loic Bade (Sevilla) makes an ugly tackle on his opponent and is sent off by the referee!
80' Jose Gaya (Valencia) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
79' Giorgi Mamardashvili (Valencia) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
79' Giorgi Mamardashvili (Valencia) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
79' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) commits a foul and Jose Sanchez immediately signals a free kick.
76' The referee blows for a cooling break.
75' Great individual play by Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) ends with a shot from distance that flies high over the bar.
75' Jose Gaya (Valencia) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
73' Jose Gaya (Valencia) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
72' Surely that's handball by one of the Sevilla players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
69' Jose Luis Mendilibar prepares a substitution. Jesus Navas is replaced by Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla).

69' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Suso sends a superb cross into the box. Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) latches on to it and from near the penalty spot powers a header into the roof of the net, leaving Giorgi Mamardashvili beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 1:1.
69' A substitution has been made. Fernando goes off and Djibril Sow (Sevilla) comes on.
68' Suso (Sevilla) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

68' Suso (Sevilla) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Sevilla force their opponents to concede a corner.
65' Ruben Baraja is forced to make a change. Diego Lopez Noguerol is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Pablo Gozalbez (Valencia).
64' Diego Lopez Noguerol (Valencia) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
63' Hugo Duro (Valencia) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
62' Ruben Baraja has decided to make a change. Javi Guerra (Valencia) replaces Andre Almeida.
61' Today's match ends for Francisco Perez who will be replaced by Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia).

60' 0 - 1 Goal! Andre Almeida plays in Mouctar Diakhaby (Valencia), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box slots it into the bottom left corner 0:1.
59' Hugo Duro (Valencia) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Bono to get hold of the ball.
57' Jose Luis Mendilibar has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Oliver Torres (Sevilla) replacing Erik Lamela.
56' Pepelu (Valencia) smashes the ball with a volley from the edge of the box, but his poor attempt goes miles wide of the left post.
55' Pepelu (Valencia) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Bono.

55' The game is interrupted. Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. A free kick has been awarded to Valencia.
53' It looks like Andre Almeida (Valencia) saw red with that tackle. Jose Sanchez won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
53' The attendance for today's match is 34184.
52' The corner is swung in but Sevilla can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
52' Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee blows his whistle, Sevilla are awarded a corner kick.
51' Sevilla failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

51' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) produces an attempt from the edge of the box which would have most likely endangered the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players blocked it, so we can only speculate about the outcome. The ball goes out of play. Sevilla are awarded a corner kick.
48' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) rises high on the edge of the box to meet a cross and plants a powerful header goalwards, but Giorgi Mamardashvili is alert and makes a decent save to deny him.
48' Erik Lamela (Sevilla) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
47' Pepelu (Valencia) produces a cross from the resulting free kick far from the goal, but there's no one to really attack the ball and the goalkeeper gathers easily.
47' Dangerous play by Fernando (Sevilla). Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Hugo Duro (Valencia) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
45+1' The game is interrupted. Hugo Duro (Valencia) suffers a horrific injury!
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) picks up a yellow card.

41' Hugo Duro (Valencia) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball goes well wide of the right post!
41' Valencia take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
37' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) jinks his way past two defenders and from the edge of the box has an effort which goes just over the bar.
37' Thierry Correia (Valencia) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
35' Diego Lopez Noguerol (Valencia) is free in the box and Francisco Perez finds him with a pass, but his powerful shot skims just past the right post. Good chance!
31' A cooling break is underway.
30' Jose Sanchez blows his whistle. Gabriel Paulista (Valencia) commits a foul after dangerous play.
29' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
26' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Sevilla, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
26' Jose Sanchez interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Francisco Perez (Valencia). Sevilla are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.

23' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Giorgi Mamardashvili. This effort really didn't trouble him.
20' Mouctar Diakhaby (Valencia) tries to find Diego Lopez Noguerol, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
18' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
17' Tempers flare after a clattering challenge by Cenk Ozkacar (Valencia), who receives a yellow card from the referee. It could have been worse for him!
15' It must be a yellow card. It is. Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
12' Diego Lopez Noguerol (Valencia) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but it's just a bit too high and misses the bar by a whisker.
10' Mouctar Diakhaby (Valencia) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jose Sanchez had an easy-decision to make.
10' Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar.
9' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
9' Erik Lamela (Sevilla) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. The ball goes out of play. Sevilla are awarded a corner kick.
8' Sevilla quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

8' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) connects with a precise cross inside the goalmouth and shoots. One of the defending players reacts in time and clears the ball to safety. The ball goes out for a corner. Sevilla can continue in their attacking effort.
8' Sevilla are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
4' Jose Gaya (Valencia) takes the free kick and curls the ball just over the crossbar. That was close!
3' Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) is penalised for holding. Jose Sanchez signals a set piece. Valencia are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
2' A pass from Diego Lopez Noguerol (Valencia) is intercepted by Bono and the move breaks down.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Valencia will have the kick-off.
The match will be delayed.
Jose Sanchez will officiate today.
